title: Patch Notes 1.18.0
body:
# Patch Notes 1.18.0

Raiders!

A new update is available to download now. Restart your client to get it.

* An exploit that let players place weapons into a safe pocket without owning the Safekeeper Augment has been fixed.

* An issue that let players stash the Snaphook in a safe pocket while it was still in use has been fixed.

* The drop rate for rare blueprints from First Wave Caches during the Hurricane map condition has been reduced slightly, while the drop rate for high tier materials from those same caches has been increased.

* Dev note: This change is mainly a response to First Wave Caches producing too many blueprints, especially since players have gotten very skilled at finding and looting them. To rebalance this, the drop rates for higher-tier materials inside the caches are being increased. This means slightly fewer blueprints overall, but better materials as compensation. Caches will still be a reliable source of blueprints, just not reliable enough to guarantee walking away with 3–5 of them every session.

* A very hot fix has been applied to the Dam Controlled Access Zone.

* An issue causing some ARC to occasionally trigger performance drops has been fixed.

* An issue that blocked completion of the final stage of the "Worth Your Salt" quest, if another player had already finished it in the same raid, has been fixed.

* A rare issue that caused players to crash while navigating to the Player Proximity menu has been fixed.

See you topside! //Ossen
